question: Should the dashboard adopt a persistent System/Light/Dark selector that reuses the docs-site `clawsweeper-theme` localStorage key across ClawSweeper surfaces?
rationale: The implementation is review-clean, but the visible preference surface and cross-surface storage contract are product/UX choices automation should not decide.

options.title: Merge the shared preference
options.body: Accept this PR's shared `clawsweeper-theme` behavior so docs and dashboard pages follow one ClawSweeper theme setting.

options.title: Use a dashboard-only key
options.body: Ask for a narrow change that keeps the selector but isolates dashboard persistence from the docs-site preference.

options.title: Decline explicit control
options.body: Keep dashboard theming system-driven and close this feature PR without changing current behavior.

recommendation.title: Merge the shared preference
recommendation.body: Accept this PR's shared `clawsweeper-theme` behavior so docs and dashboard pages follow one ClawSweeper theme setting.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged dashboard visual redesign that this PR extends, so they are the strongest routing candidate for the UX preference decision.
